fact: Newsmada reports that Madagascar has a 2015 law on electronic signatures, which it describes as the legal equivalent of the handwritten signature; the article's date of 2025-09-13 is used for the report, 2015 for the law.

fact: A draft decree on electronic signature and interoperability was in preparation, and the ministry held a validation workshop on the regulatory framework on the article's date (2025-09-13, the publication date used as the document gives no other).
system: Projet de décret sur la signature électronique

fact: Newsmada states the 2015 electronic signature law remained without an implementing decree, and the draft decree would give it effective application; the date used is the article's publication date.
system: Loi de 2015 sur la signature électronique

fact: Decree 2024-1911 of the President (published 2024-11-13) cites law no. 2014-024 of 10 December 2014 on electronic transactions and law no. 2014-025 of 10 December 2014 on electronic signature as the legal basis it is made under, and its Article 10 gives documents signed through a certified electronic signature device the same recognition as paper.
system: Loi n°2014-024 sur les transactions électroniques

fact: Loi n° 2014-024 sur les transactions électroniques, a 35-article law in four parts defining electronic signature and regulating e-commerce in Madagascar, is dated 10 December 2014; the passages held do not state its entry into force, and the date is the document's published date.
